name: contextarmor
description: Audit AI exposure locally, track private risk trends, and create sanitized copies.

interface.shortDescription: Audit AI exposure and protect work locally.
interface.longDescription: ContextArmor audits explicitly selected AI conversation records without printing detected values, stores private day and week trends locally, and creates deterministic sanitized copies before supported files are read by an agent.
capabilities: Private day and week risk trends
defaultPrompt: Audit these AI conversation records locally and show today's and this week's exposure trends.
Make an AI-safe copy of these files before reading them.
Scan this workspace for secrets and create sanitized copies.
